statement: Let N be an s-t network on exactly 4 vertices whose arcs have pairwise distinct positive integer capacities and whose maximum s-t flow value is positive. Then N has exactly one minimum s-t cut.
definitions: An s-t network is a finite loopless digraph on the stated vertex set (isolated vertices permitted) with s != t and positive integer arc capacities. An s-t cut is a vertex set S with s in S, t not in S, with capacity the sum of capacities of arcs from S to V\S; two cuts are distinct if the vertex sets differ; a minimum cut is one of minimum capacity.
